svg.title: Conflict resolution: edits to different columns both survive, and the same column follows server arrival order.
svg.desc: Conflicts resolve per column. Sarah's phone and David's tablet each keep a local copy of one todos row, and your Supabase project holds that row with the columns title, done, and notes. First Sarah edits title and done while David edits notes. Each device pushes a mutation whose mask names only the columns it changed, the server writes only those columns, both mutations come back applied, and the merged row pulls back to both devices, so both edits survive. Then both devices edit title. Sarah's value arrives first and is written; David's arrives second and replaces it. Both verdicts are applied, and Sarah's phone learns David's title on its next pull. In the default arrival mode, the later arrival holds the column.
svg.text: In the default arrival mode, edits to different columns both survive; the same column follows server arrival order.
